entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Bob, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Bob, I'd like to start a return for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought.
Okay, certainly. I can definitely help you with that. Let me just pull up your account here... Yep, I see the order from late December.
Alright, it looks like you're well within the return window. We have a 90 days return policy, so that's no problem at all.
Oh, fantastic. I wasn't sure what the timeframe was, so that's a relief.
Absolutely. I've just processed the request and sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should see it in your inbox any moment now.
Wow, that was fast. Thank you.
You're very welcome. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a 20% discount code to your account for your next purchase with us.
That's really nice of you, Bob! I appreciate that. This was much easier than I expected.
We aim to please! Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
